evidence_boundary: This v2 report inventories final Pandoc Link/Image nodes and binds the exact P8 plan, output manifest and canonical AST bytes. Structure-only mode proves that deterministic inventory and target syntax, not reachability. Live mode records one bounded observation per unique valid external HTTPS target. HTTP 200/206 does not prove source authority, citation entailment, content truth, accessibility or future availability. Inconclusive and access-controlled results require human review and are never auto-passed. Zero final Image nodes does not prove source Markdown contained no image syntax because v2 never reconstructs pre-publication syntax. Machine results cannot promote chapters or learner progress.

extraction_policy.source: bound P8 canonical Pandoc AST output
